crossRefs.note: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says, “Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.
“If you will return, Israel,” says Yahweh, “if you will return to me, and if you will put away your abominations out of…
and you will swear, ‘As Yahweh lives,’ in truth, in justice, and in righteousness. The nations will bless themselves in…
If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the good of the land;
Then Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam sang on that day, saying,
They found among the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead four hundred young virgins who had not known man by lying with him…
“Concerning this house which you are building, if you will walk in my statutes, and execute my ordinances, and keep all…
I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.”
Give counsel! Execute justice! Make your shade like the night in the middle of the noonday! Hide the outcasts! Don’t…
he who hasn’t lent to them with interest, hasn’t taken any increase from them, who has withdrawn his hand from…
who has withdrawn his hand from the poor, who hasn’t received interest or increase, has executed my ordinances, has…

translations.web: For if you thoroughly amend your ways and your doings, if you thoroughly execute justice between a man and his neighbor;
translations.bsb: For if you really correct your ways and deeds, if you act justly toward one another,
translations.kjv: For if ye throughly amend your ways and your doings; if ye throughly execute judgment between a man and his neighbour;
translations.asv: For if ye thoroughly amend your ways and your doings; if ye thoroughly execute justice between a man and his neighbor;
